findings.title: EVIDENCE_STALE protected-X reconciliation creates rollback but leaves rollout in a state from which rollback dispatch is forbidden
findings.requirement: The round-12 correction requires exact settled X/N continuations after IC24-A, one rollback for X, one cleanup owner for N, preserved Effect identity, and a legal path to rollback/cleanup settlement. Closed-row semantics forbid inventing an omitted synchronized rollout delta.
evidence: IC24-A may preserve candidate EVIDENCE_STALE while moving an unsettled widening or promotion Effect to WIDENING_RECONCILING or PROMOTION_RECONCILING.

IC24-RWX and IC24-RPX create or reuse rollback IDLE->REQUESTED, but neither row states a synchronized rollout target. By contrast, the analogous IC32-RWX/RPX rows explicitly move WIDENING_RECONCILING->CANARY_ABORTING and PROMOTION_RECONCILING->FAILED.
Manifest §1 says a closed row does not permit an unlisted delta. The prose following IC24-RWX/RPX says only that the X rows create/reuse rollback; it supplies no rollout transition.
IRB01 permits REQUESTED->ROLLING_BACK only when rollout is not WIDENING_RECONCILING or PROMOTION_RECONCILING. Thus the rollback created by either IC24 protected-X row cannot dispatch.
IC32-RWX/RPX cannot repair the path without a later revocation event, and the new IC24 continuation contract explicitly says unrelated revocation is not required.
findings.impact: A reachable digest-change-before-Effect-settlement race can settle as protected exposure, request the required rollback, and then strand both rollout and rollback indefinitely. Cleanup and terminal settlement remain unreachable unless an unrelated event occurs. This is an unsafe and undefined recovery path in the formal plan.
findings.required_correction: Make IC24-RWX atomically synchronize WIDENING_RECONCILING->CANARY_ABORTING and bind WIDENING_ABORT origin, and make IC24-RPX atomically synchronize PROMOTION_RECONCILING->FAILED with its non-widening origin, matching the legal dispatch preconditions and the analogous IC32 rows. Update exact tuple/race witnesses and regenerate current schema-3 digests after normative-byte changes.

residual_uncertainty: The accepted future exhaustive reachable-product execution may reveal additional guard-level gaps; it was not treated as completed or as a present closure prerequisite.
Fresh immutable retrieval and same-run human semantic review remain future evidence gates and do not affect this formal-path finding.
